description: This file defines an S4 class 'Column' for representing Spark DataFrame columns in R, along with methods for various column operations such as arithmetic, comparison, string manipulation, and structural modifications. It includes method definitions, class setup, and function creation for column operations in SparkR.

classes.name: Column
classes.description: An S4 class representing a Spark DataFrame column, supporting unary and binary operations.

methods.name: initialize
methods.description: Initializes a Column object with a JVM reference.

methods.name: column
methods.description: Creates a Column object from a JVM object.

methods.name: alias
methods.description: Creates an alias for a Column.

methods.name: substr
methods.description: Returns a substring of a Column.

methods.name: startsWith
methods.description: Checks if Column entries start with a prefix.

methods.name: endsWith
methods.description: Checks if Column entries end with a suffix.

methods.name: between
methods.description: Checks if Column values are between two bounds.

methods.name: cast
methods.description: Casts a Column to a different data type.

methods.name: %in%
methods.description: Checks if Column values are in a list of values.

methods.name: otherwise
methods.description: Replaces null values in a Column with a specified value.

methods.name: withField
methods.description: Adds or replaces a field in a struct Column.

methods.name: dropFields
methods.description: Drops specified fields from a struct Column.
